description:
Look up one identifier in ENYAL's PUBLIC verification index (relays GET /api/v1/verify/lookup/{id}; no decryption). ENYAL's
    answer is returned unchanged: `found`, and for a chunk or proof its `anchor_status` with `bsv_tx_id`; for a txid, `chain_status`.
    `degraded:true` means a source could not be checked (inconclusive, not an absence). ENYAL's route needs no key; calling it through
    this server still needs your eyl_ bearer, like every tool call. An id that is not a UUID or hex is refused (invalid_id) and nothing
    is sent.

identifier.description: The id to look up: a chunk, proof or transfer id (UUID), or a BSV transaction id (hex), 8-64 characters.
identifier.title: Identifier

name: verify_chunk
